postingDescription: Original commentary narration and edit by Primeplug over public reusable footage.
narrationScript: These Cape fox pups have turned a dry patch of savanna into their own play arena. One pup stands guard first, giant ears up, scanning the grass like a tiny sentinel. Then its sibling arrives and the digging contest begins, paws flying everywhere. Whatever they are hunting stays hidden, but the effort deserves a medal.
